notes.title: Get Together is now verified for Steam Deck!
notes.content:
[h2]Hi everyone. [/h2]

We are happy to announce that Get Together has been officially verified for Steam Deck. Puzzle your way through challenging levels on the go or super comfy on your couch :)

As usual, don't forget to bring a friend along and enjoy a great coop time together!

We wish you (and your partner) a great experience,
The Team

notes.title: Patchnotes 1.0.2
notes.content:
Hi All,
we fixed an issue about entering windowed mode with Alt+Enter and resizing it. 
Note: Sometimes the resizing cursor doesn't show up, it will still work though.

If you encounter any problems please don't hesitate to contact us!
